_comment: Seed precedent store for DECIDE-Bench. Replace/extend with real org decisions. Authority tiers: guardrail > policy > precedent. Scope is by path glob + team.

precedents.situation: New customer-facing dashboards need server-state caching.
precedents.decision: Use React Query (@tanstack/react-query) for server state.
precedents.reasoning: Redux caused stale-cache bugs in PR #82, #119, #144.

precedents.situation: Server-state caching library choice on the web team.
precedents.decision: Redux is banned for server-state caching.
precedents.reasoning: Same stale-cache incidents as E1; the failure mode is intrinsic to using Redux for server truth.

precedents.situation: The realtime collaborative editor has different state needs than dashboards.
precedents.decision: E1/E2 do NOT apply to the realtime editor; use the CRDT store.
precedents.reasoning: Editor state is collaborative/local-first, not server-truth caching.

precedents.decision: Enforce idempotency keys in the payment service, not the API gateway.
precedents.reasoning: Gateway-level dedupe missed mobile retries (INC-1842, INC-2031); the payment service owns final charge semantics.

precedents.decision: Do NOT use DB transaction locks in the checkout flow.
precedents.reasoning: A prior attempt caused a checkout latency spike.

precedents.situation: Catalog datastore migration from MongoDB to Postgres because joins became painful.
precedents.decision: New catalog code targets Postgres; the Mongo adapter remains only during cutover.
precedents.reasoning: Migration in progress; do not build new read paths on Mongo.

precedents.situation: SOC-2 compliance requires audit trails on service endpoints.
precedents.decision: All new service endpoints must apply the audit-logging middleware.
precedents.reasoning: Compliance requirement; documented in the wiki, not derivable from code.

precedents.decision: Keep the hot path standard-library only; embeddings/model calls are optional and must degrade gracefully (no hard third-party dep to run govern/retrieve locally).
precedents.reasoning: zero-install adoption by agents; the deterministic gate must never require a model.

precedents.decision: The engine is vendored into a target repo by `init` (self-contained under .precedent/engine/); a pip package is a fast-follow, not a prerequisite.
precedents.reasoning: an agent must be able to set up Precedent in any repo offline, in one command.

precedents.decision: Never commit secrets (API keys) to git; they live in .precedent/.env (gitignored) or a secret manager.
precedents.reasoning: the store and keys stay in the customer's environment.
